# Copilot instructions

This repository is the iVendNext partner kit. Read [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) in full before you suggest or write anything: it holds the five ways in, the four rules, the commands and what you must never do.
Before you say anything is ready, run `python3 tools/check/check.py <project folder>` and report its verdict line (or that it found nothing to check, and which tests you ran instead). Ask the person before any write to a shop.
